title.en: Eurovision Song Contest 2027 to be held in Burgas, Bulgaria
title.zh: 2027年欧洲歌唱大赛将在保加利亚布尔加斯举行

summary.en: The city of Burgas, Bulgaria, has been chosen to host the Eurovision Song Contest in 2027. This decision follows the victory of Bulgarian singer Dara in this year's competition.
summary.zh: 保加利亚城市布尔加斯已被选定为2027年欧洲歌唱大赛的主办城市。此决定是在保加利亚歌手达拉赢得今年的比赛后作出的。

body.en:
Eurovision 2027 will be a seaside song contest held in the Bulgarian city of Burgas, organiseres have confirmed.

The competition will take place in the city, which is close to the Black Sea, from 12 to 15 May, the European Broadcasting Union (EBU) and Bulgarian National Television (BNT) confirmed.

It comes after Bulgarian singer Dara won this year's contest in Vienna, Austria in May - her country's first Eurovision win - with her pneumatic dance anthem Bangaranga.

Eurovision Song Contest director Martin Green said they were "delighted" with the next choice of destination, adding that Burgas would "bring something really special" to the competition.

The contest, including rehearsals, the semi-finals and grand final, will be held at Bulgaria's newest sports and entertainment venue, Arena Burgas, which was opened in 2023.

"[Burgas] is a vibrant, welcoming city on the Black Sea with a strong musical and cultural identity, and it has the ambition, infrastructure and passion needed to welcome the Eurovision family," Green said.

"For the first Eurovision Song Contest ever to be held in Bulgaria, we want to create something that feels truly Bulgarian while also being unmistakably Eurovision – a celebration that brings people together through music."

Bulgaria's second largest city was selected for its "strong overall proposition, combining the venue and technical potential" - including hotel capacity, transport and international travel.

It may come as a surprise to some Eurovision watchers that the contest will be held there and not in the capital, Sofia.

Speaking at a press conference after the most recent song contest in May, the director of BNT, Milena Miltenova, said: "I'm so proud of Dara's performance. What she did last night was amazing. And I'm so proud to say welcome to Sofia next year."

Dara - the winning contestant - said something similar: "I'm so happy that you're coming to Sofia next year. I'm happy that it [Eurovision] is going to be in my home."

However, the EBU said Burgas was selected following a "competitive" process involving four Bulgarian cities.

Burgas and Sofia progressed to the final stage of the selection process following the initial bids, which also included Varna and Plovdiv.

Miltenova has said she is now "confident" that Bulgaria will be a "worthy" host and the country would "showcase the very best of our culture, hospitality and professionalism".

She added there would now be "an intensive period of collaboration" between all involved in order "to deliver a contest that meets the high expectations of millions of viewers around the world".

The Eurovision Song Contest can have an impact beyond the stage, with the event providing a platform for cities and nations to showcase themselves to audiences around the...
body.zh: 组织者确认，2027 年欧洲歌唱大赛将在保加利亚城市布尔加斯举行海滨歌曲比赛。 欧洲广播联盟 (EBU) 和保加利亚国家电视台 (BNT) 证实，比赛将于 5 月 12 日至 15 日在靠近黑海的城市举行。 此前，保加利亚歌手达拉 (Dara) 凭借她的气动舞曲《班加兰加》(Bangaranga) 于今年 5 月在奥地利维也纳赢得了今年的比赛，这是她的国家首次在欧洲歌唱大赛中获胜。 欧洲歌唱大赛总监马丁·格林表示，他们对下一个目的地的选择感到“高兴”，并补充说布尔加斯将为比赛“带来一些真正特别的东西”。 比赛包括排练、半决赛和总决赛，将在保加利亚最新的体育和娱乐场馆布尔加斯竞技场举行，该场馆于 2023 年开业。 “[布尔加斯]是黑海沿岸一座充满活力、热情好客的城市，具有强烈的音乐和文化特征，并且拥有欢迎欧洲电视网大家庭所需的雄心、基础设施和热情，”格林说。 “对于在保加利亚举办的第一届欧洲歌唱大赛，我们希望创造出真正保加利亚风格的东西，同时也具有明显的欧洲歌唱大赛的特色——一场通过音乐将人们聚集在一起的庆祝活动。” 保加利亚第二大城市因其“强大的整体主张，结合了场地和技术潜力”而被选中，包括酒店容量、交通和国际旅行。 一些欧洲歌唱大赛的观察者可能会感到惊讶，比赛将在那里举行，而不是在首都索非亚。 BNT 总监米莱娜·米尔特诺娃 (Milena Miltenova) 在 5 月份最近一次歌曲比赛结束后的新闻发布会上表示：“我为达拉的表演感到非常自豪。她昨晚的表现令人惊叹。我很自豪地欢迎明年来到索非亚。” 获胜选手达拉也说了类似的话：“我很高兴你明年能来到索非亚。我很高兴它[欧洲电视网]将在我家举行。” 然而，EBU 表示，布尔加斯是在涉及四个保加利亚城市的“竞争”过程后被选中的。 布尔加斯和索非亚在初步投标后进入了选择过程的最后阶段，其中还包括瓦尔纳和普罗夫迪夫。 米尔特诺娃表示，她现在“相信”保加利亚将成为“值得”的东道主，该国将“展示我们最好的文化、热情好客和专业精神”。 她补充说，现在所有参与者之间将进行“一段密集的合作”，以便“举办一场满足全球数百万观众高度期望的比赛”。 欧洲歌唱大赛可以产生舞台之外的影响，该活动为城市和国家提供了一个向世界各地的观众展示自己的平台。

reflection.en: The excitement of winning a prestigious contest like Eurovision is a testament to talent and dedication. While such achievements bring joy and recognition, Yahweh's Word reminds us to pursue a crown that is imperishable. May we celebrate earthly successes with gratitude, while also investing in what truly lasts.
reflection.zh: 赢得欧洲歌唱大赛这样享有盛誉的比赛，是对才华和奉献精神的证明，令人振奋。虽然这些成就带来喜悦和认可，但雅伟的话语提醒我们去追求那永不朽坏的冠冕。愿我们怀着感恩之心庆祝世俗的成功，同时也投资于真正持久的事物。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。

title.en: UK defends seizing shadow fleet tanker after Putin threat
title.zh: 英国在普京威胁后为扣押影子舰队油轮进行辩护

summary.en: The UK government says it is "disrupting and deterring shadow fleet vessels" in accordance with the law.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The UK government has defended its seizure of a Russian "shadow fleet" oil tanker in the English Channel, after Russian President Vladimir Putin threatened to "respond in kind".

The Smyrtos has been anchored off Weymouth after Royal Marines Commandos intercepted and boarded the vessel in a first-of-its-kind operation to disrupt the sanctioned tanker in June.

The vessel's captain, Ajay Pant, has been charged with breaching Russian sanctions, accused of directly or indirectly supplying or delivering prohibited Russian oil.

Overseeing Russian navy drills in the Pacific Ocean, Putin scolded Western countries for "seizing our vessels", branding such action "nothing other than piracy and banditry".

Western nations allege Russia has been operating a "shadow fleet" of hundreds of vessels to evade international sanctions imposed on its oil exports.

These vessels stand accused of using complex ownership structures and various tactics to obscure the origin of their cargo, masking their link to Russia.

The UK Ministry of Defence says Russia has a fleet of more than 700 vessels, responsible for carrying 75% of the country's sanctioned oil.

This oil is a "critical lifeline for the Kremlin" in "sustaining Russia's illegal war" in Ukraine, the MoD says.

On Wednesday, Putin warned Western countries against seizing more of these tankers, saying: "If these plans are put into practice, we will have to respond in kind.

"And not necessarily in the waters where raids on our ships and vessels are planned, but wherever we deem it necessary and appropriate, anywhere."

Viktor Liina, commander of Russia's Pacific Fleet, accused Western countries such as Britain and France of operating their own "shadow fleets".

"We have the capacity to inspect and detain vessels of unfriendly states and their shadow fleets, and interagency cooperation is in place, ready to begin addressing these challenges," Liina said.

In response to Putin's comments, the UK government said Britain's armed forces and law-enforcement officers had boarded the Smyrtos "in full accordance with international law".

"The UK is disrupting and deterring shadow fleet vessels and their harmful maritime activity which is fuelling Russia's war with Ukraine," a government spokesperson said.

The spokesperson said unlike Russia's shadow fleet, "UK armed forces and commercial vessels operate firmly in line with international maritime law".

The Smyrtos continues to be detained by the Department of Transport at a port near Weymouth in southern England, where is it being monitored by British authorities.

The ship owner is responsible for the upkeep of the vessel, including provision of supplies for crew members on board.

body.zh: 在俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京威胁要“以牙还牙”后，英国政府为其在英吉利海峡扣押一艘俄罗斯“影子舰队”油轮进行了辩护。 六月份，皇家海军陆战队突击队拦截并登上了这艘油轮，这是史无前例的破坏这艘受制裁油轮的行动，之后，“Smyrtos”号就停泊在韦茅斯附近。 该船的船长阿贾伊·潘特（Ajay Pant）被指控违反俄罗斯制裁，被指控直接或间接供应或运送俄罗斯违禁石油。 普京在监督俄罗斯海军在太平洋演习时，谴责西方国家“扣押我们的船只”，称这种行为“只不过是海盗和土匪行为”。 西方国家指控俄罗斯一直在运营一支由数百艘船只组成的“影子舰队”，以逃避国际社会对其石油出口的制裁。 这些船只被指控使用复杂的所有权结构和各种策略来掩盖其货物的来源，掩盖其与俄罗斯的联系。 英国国防部表示，俄罗斯拥有一支由700多艘船只组成的船队，负责运输该国75%的受制裁石油。 英国国防部表示，这种石油是“克里姆林宫维持俄罗斯在乌克兰的非法战争”的“重要生命线”。 周三，普京警告西方国家不要扣押更多此类油轮，他说：“如果这些计划付诸实施，我们将不得不做出同样的回应。 “不一定是在计划袭击我们船只的水域，而是在我们认为必要和适当的任何地方。” 俄罗斯太平洋舰队司令维克托·利纳指责英国、法国等西方国家运营自己的“影子舰队”。 利纳说：“我们有能力检查和扣押不友好国家的船只及其影子舰队，而且机构间合作已经到位，准备开始应对这些挑战。” 作为对普京言论的回应，英国政府表示，英国武装部队和执法人员“完全按照国际法”登上了“斯米尔托”号。 一位政府发言人表示：“英国正在扰乱和威慑影子舰队及其有害的海上活动，这正在加剧俄罗斯与乌克兰的战争。” 该发言人表示，与俄罗斯影子舰队不同，“英国武装部队和商船的运作严格遵守国际海事法”。 “斯米尔托”号继续被交通部扣押在英格兰南部韦茅斯附近的一个港口，并受到英国当局的监控。 船东负责船舶的维护，包括为船上船员提供补给品。 普京发出警告之际，欧盟加大了对俄罗斯影子的压力……

reflection.en: This story draws attention to justice, dignity, and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with justice tempered by mercy, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到公义、尊严与问责。Micah 6:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以带着怜悯的公义来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

summary.en: Official figures indicate that economic growth slowed in the second quarter of the year, a development attributed to the disruption caused by the ongoing Iran war.
summary.zh: 官方数据显示，今年第二季度经济增长放缓，这被归因于伊朗战争所带来的扰乱。

body.en: The Reform UK leader resigned as the MP for Clacton at the start of July and forced a byelection Yesterday Michael Shanks , a UK energy minister, criticised John Swinney , the SNP Scottish first miniser, for trying to get Andy Burnham to lift a ban on the Chinese firm Ming Yang building a wind turbine factory in the Highlands. Today Stephen Gethins , energy minister in the Scottish government, defended his boss. In an interview on BBC Radio Scotland’s Breakfast programme, Gethins said: The first minister is right to ask about this. This is 1,500 jobs in the north of Scotland. It’s also an area that is being transformed by that move towards offshore renewables, Scotland continuing to contribute. It’s an area which is, in general terms, important for security. Scotland is contributing to European energy security, which is a concern across Europe when you speak to leaders there. Why should I be judged, today or in history in the future, by Sky News and their ilk? Why should they be the people that decide my fate when, as I repeat, I’ve done nothing wrong. I’m being judged as being guilty every single day by newspapers, broadcasters and elsewhere. Continue reading...
body.zh: 官方数据显示，英国改革派领导人于7月初辞去克拉克顿议员职务，并被迫举行补选。官方数据显示，随着伊朗战争造成的破坏开始造成影响，今年第二季度经济增长放缓。希瑟·斯图尔特有这个故事。早上好。在媒体中，八月被称为“愚蠢的季节”。由于议会不开会，许多人都在度假，正确的新闻比平时少，这意味着无稽之谈会比平时得到（甚至）更多的关注。月中即将到来，今天我们在克拉克顿迎来了一个愚蠢的季节经典，其中改革英国候选人奈杰尔·法拉奇正在进行一场补选，他的主要对手是一个装扮成垃圾箱的笑话候选人。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of economic slowdown due to conflict reminds us of the far-reaching consequences of war, impacting lives beyond the battlefield. Psalm 46:9 offers a vision of Yahweh's ultimate power to bring an end to all conflicts, breaking weapons and making wars cease. This hope encourages us to pray for peace and for an end to the global disruptions caused by...
reflection.zh: 战争导致经济放缓的消息提醒我们，冲突的影响深远，超越了战场，波及到人们的生活。诗篇46:9描绘了雅伟最终止息一切争战、折弓断矛的异象。这份盼望鼓励我们为和平祷告，并祈求人类纷争所造成的全球性扰乱能够止息。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: Europe heatwave live: Temperatures of 40C expected in Spain, with amber heat health warning in place across large parts of UK
title.zh: 欧洲热浪：西班牙预计气温达40摄氏度，英国大部分地区发布琥珀色高温健康预警

summary.en: A severe heatwave is gripping Europe, with temperatures expected to reach 40C in Spain and amber heat health warnings issued across large parts of the UK. France has placed 80 departments on an orange heat warning as the extreme weather continues.
summary.zh: 欧洲正经历一场严重热浪，西班牙预计气温将达到40摄氏度，英国大部分地区已发布琥珀色高温健康预警。法国有80个省份已进入橙色高温预警，极端天气仍在持续。

body.en:
Meanwhile, Le Figaro is reporting that with the current heatwave extending into its 17th day, it is now the third longest period of extreme temperatures ever recorded in France.

It’s 38C in Bordeaux and Nantes , 36C in Paris , and 34C in Montpellier at the moment.
body.zh: 据 PA 报道，法国已有 80 个部门发布橙色高温警报。在英国，英国气象局发布的黄色警报从伦敦延伸至谢菲尔德，覆盖东南部、东米德兰兹、英格兰东部、西米德兰兹和南约克郡的部分地区，警报时间为周四上午 9 点至午夜。英国气象局预报员亚历克斯·伯基尔 (Alex Burkill) 表示：“[在黄色预警覆盖的地区]气温可能会达到 36 摄氏度、37 摄氏度，甚至可能达到 38 摄氏度左右。现在，当出现这种高温时，我们的基础设施、铁路线、道路就会受到影响，因为它们不是为这种高温而设计的。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The widespread heatwave across Europe reminds us that creation itself is under strain, groaning under the weight of present realities. In these moments, we are called to both care for one another and reflect on our stewardship of the earth Yahweh has entrusted to us.
reflection.zh: 欧洲各地普遍出现的热浪提醒我们，受当前现实的重压，受造界本身也在呻吟。在这样的时刻，我们蒙召彼此关怀，并反思我们对雅伟所托付大地的管家责任。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

body.en: Move blocking funds through Medicaid and Chip to make it harder for vulnerable children to get healthcare, experts say The Trump administration finalized a rule on Tuesday to end gender-affirming care through Medicaid and the Children’s Health Insurance Program (Chip), a move that will make it harder for vulnerable children to access healthcare and that eschews evidence to advance an anti-transgender ideology, opponents say. The rule is set to take effect on 13 October – but legal challenges could delay or block it entirely. Continue reading...

title.en: What would a North Korean surge mean for Ukraine war?
title.zh: 朝鲜增兵对乌克兰战争意味着什么？

summary.en: Ukraine is claiming that North Korea is preparing to send tens of thousands more troops to Russia, where they'll gain valuable battlefield experience. President Zelenskyy has urged South Korea to work closer with Kyiv.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Ukraine is claiming that North Korea is preparing to send tens of thousands more troops to Russia, where they'll gain valuable battlefield experience. President Zelenskyy has urged South Korea to work closer with Kyiv.

North Korea is preparing a massive troop surge to help its ally Moscow in its war on Ukraine , with up to 50,000 North Koreans to be deployed in Russia , according to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy .

In late July, the Ukrainian leader said Russia wanted to bring in another 30,000 North Korean troops, before adding this weekend that Pyongyang decided to have between 30,000 and 50,000 North Koreans deployed on Russian territory. He did not specify if this number included the North Korean troops already taking part in the conflict.

In the comments published this weekend, Zelenskyy also warned North Korea was gaining valuable experience in modern warfare and urged South Korea to boost cooperation with Ukraine on air defense and drones. Two days later, Zelenskyy said Russia had received more North Korean ballistic missiles, which were allegedly used in an attack on Zaporizhzhia.

Russia and North Korea signed a defense pact in the summer of 2024, with North Korea starting to send combat troops to Russia several months later . Analyst believe some 14,000 to 15,000 personnel were deployed, mainly in the Kursk region.

Pyongyang later agreed to send another 6,000 sappers and military construction workers. North Korea has also supplied Russia with millions of artillery rounds and ballistic missiles, according to South Korean and Ukrainian authorities. South Korean intelligence estimates that around 6,000 North Korean soldiers have been killed or wounded.

On Thursday, Japan's Kyodo News cited Ukrainian military intelligence as confirming the upcoming North Korean surge. Ukrainian sources say up to 50,000 North Korean troops could be deployed to Russia by the end of November; The troops would reportedly take over duties in Russia's Kursk, Bryansk and Belgorod, freeing Russian forces for the Ukrainian front.

South Korean lawmaker Yu Yong-won told DW the military cooperation between Russia and Korea was growing ever closer.

Yu is a former military journalist who visited Ukraine in 2025 and again in February this year. He said he heard claims of the North Korean surge during his most recent visit to the war-torn country.

Yu noted that 30,000 to 50,000 troops would be significantly more than the roughly 20,000 troops and support forces involved in the initial deployment.

"Whether such a large-scale additional troop deployment will actually take place," Yu said, "the continued expansion of military cooperation between Pyongyang and Moscow called closer attention from the South Korean government and military."

title.en: Zambians voting as president bids for second term
title.zh: 赞比亚总统投票竞选第二任期

summary.en: Hakainde Hichilema wants five more years but continued cost of living pressures have dented his appeal.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Zambians are voting in an election to choose a president and parliament, with more than eight million voters registered to cast their ballots.

The vote is seen as a test of Zambia's reputation as one of Africa's most stable democracies, amid concerns that political freedoms are being undermined. Unemployment and the rising cost of living remain major issues for voters.

President Hakainde Hichilema is seeking a second term after steering Zambia through an economic rebound. But many complain that living costs remain high.

Fourteen candidates are on the ballot, but the contest is largely seen as a two-horse race between the incumbent and his main challenger Brian Mundubile.

Mundubile is a former minister in the Patriotic Front (PF) government that ruled from 2011 to 2021, with his alliance drawing support from backers of the late former President, Edgar Lungu.

Lungu died more than a year ago and his body remains unburied in South Africa, amid a bitter dispute between Lungu's family and Hichilema, which has heightened political divisions in Zambia.

Hichilema, 64, won the 2021 election on his sixth attempt and is betting on job creation and an ambitious infrastructure drive to secure a final five-year term.

Mwiche Nalupumbwe, 26, was among hundreds who braved the morning chill to queue at polling stations well before they opened.

"Zambians are frustrated and this election is a 50-50, that is why we are all here early to make the change," he told the AFP news agency.

"I voted for HH because he cares about us," James Phiri, a 29-year-old student at the University of Zambia, told the Reuters news agency, using a common nickname for the president.

Samuel Chitendwe, a 47-year-old welder and father of four, said he voted for Mundubile.

"I have just come from firing someone. We are tired of stories about economic progress," he told Reuters.

A presidential candidate needs more than 50% to win outright or face a run-off, which must be held within 37 days.
body.zh: 赞比亚人正在选举总统和议会，已有超过八百万选民登记投票。 由于担心政治自由受到破坏，此次投票被视为对赞比亚作为非洲最稳定民主国家之一声誉的考验。失业和生活成本上升仍然是选民面临的主要问题。 总统哈坎德·希奇莱马在带领赞比亚实现经济反弹后正在寻求连任。但许多人抱怨生活成本仍然很高。 共有 14 名候选人参加投票，但这场竞争在很大程度上被视为现任总统和他的主要挑战者布莱恩·蒙杜比莱 (Brian Mundubile) 之间的两匹马竞赛。 蒙杜比莱是爱国阵线 (PF) 政府的前部长，该政府于 2011 年至 2021 年执政，他的联盟得到了已故前总统埃德加·伦古 (Edgar Lungu) 的支持者的支持。 伦古去世一年多前，他的尸体仍未埋葬在南非，伦古的家人与希奇莱马之间存在激烈争执，加剧了赞比亚的政治分歧。 64 岁的希奇莱马第六次赢得 2021 年大选，并押注于创造就业机会和雄心勃勃的基础设施建设，以确保最后的五年任期。 26 岁的 Mwiche Nalupumbwe 是数百人中的一员，他们冒着早晨的寒冷，在投票站开放前就到投票站排队。 他告诉法新社：“赞比亚人感到沮丧，这次选举的结果是 50 比 50，这就是为什么我们很早就来这里做出改变。” “我投票给 HH，因为他关心我们，”赞比亚大学 29 岁的学生詹姆斯·菲里 (James Phiri) 告诉路透社，他使用了总统的常用昵称。 47 岁的焊工、四个孩子的父亲塞缪尔·奇滕维 (Samuel Chitendwe) 表示，他投票给了蒙杜比莱。 “我刚刚解雇了某人。我们厌倦了有关经济进步的故事，”他告诉路透社。 总统候选人需要超过 50% 的支持率才能彻底获胜，否则将面临决选，决选必须在 37 天内举行。

title.en: Twitch users outraged as Amazon uses their content to train AI in opt-out feature
title.zh: Twitch用户现在可以阻止亚马逊使用其内容训练人工智能

summary.en: Streaming platform Twitch has introduced a new feature allowing its users to opt out of having their channel content used by Amazon for training artificial intelligence. This change comes after users expressed criticism regarding the company's initial policy on AI training data.
summary.zh: 直播平台Twitch推出了一项新功能，允许用户选择不让亚马逊将其频道内容用于训练人工智能。此举是在用户对该公司最初的人工智能训练数据政策提出批评后推出的。

body.en:
Twitch has been criticised by users after it emerged the popular streaming platform allowed their content to be used to train Amazon's AI models.

Amazon owns Twitch and a setting allowing the US tech giant to take data generated by creators and audiences to train AI is turned on by default.

Users can opt out of that, Twitch said on Wednesday , external , but the announcement sparked a backlash with some users questioning why it was allowed in the first place.

Twitch's chief product officer Mike Minton, said it was "respecting" users by letting them opt out but on why data was collected by default, he admitted: "If it's opt-in, nobody would opt-in. That's the honest answer."

Users who remain opted in could have any of their channel content used for training, Minton said during a livestream, adding that the data collected will not be re-sold to other companies.

In Twitch's own FAQs about its use of AI , external , it says if users do not opt out, their content could be used to train generative AI models.

Generative AI is a type of artificial intelligence which creates new content, such as text, images and video. Chabots like OpenAI's ChatGPT and Google's Gemini are both examples of the tech.

For example, Twitch said a person's audio might be used to "refine models that create speech to text". It said this would help improve automatic subtitles on Twitch streams as well as Amazon videos.

Some also questioned , external what the implications could be for game developers, given the feature would also seemingly train Amazon's AI models on the countless video games being played by streamers.

"On by default is criminal.... the AI narrative push is so draining," said one streamer , external underneath Twitch Support's post about the feature.

On the same livestream, Mary Kish, head of community at Twitch, took viewers through a tutorial on how to disable generative AI training through a user's channel settings.

Those that do want to disable it would need to navigate to the Settings tab in their Streamer Dashboard, click the Security and Privacy tab, then scroll down to near the bottom of the options and toggle off "training for Generative AI".

Doing so will prevent Amazon from using streams, clips, images, chats and other channel content to train its generative AI models.

Some users have since said despite toggling off the option, they have then returned to the settings to find the feature turned on again.

"Went in and toggled the switch off, exited, went back in, switch is still on," one said , external .

"We don't expect you to be happy or excited about this. I don't expect anyone to react to this favourably," she added.

The stream's chat column was flooded with hundreds of comments from users criticising the move.

title.en: Japan PM says Putin's visit to disputed islands 'absolutely unacceptable'
title.zh: 日本抗议普京访问争议岛屿

summary.en: Japan has formally protested Russia's President Vladimir Putin's visit to the Kuril Islands, a territory disputed by both nations, marking his first visit there according to Russian state media.
summary.zh: 据俄罗斯官方媒体报道，日本已就俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京首次访问两国存在争议的千岛群岛（日本称北方四岛）一事提出抗议。

body.en:
Japan's Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has criticised Vladimir Putin's first-ever visit to the disputed Kuril islands on Thursday as "absolutely unacceptable".

Russian state media reported that Putin visited Iturup, known in Japan as Etorofu, one of four islands in the Kuril chain that are claimed by Russia and Japan.

Putin's trip "has worsened Japanese sentiment towards Russia," Takaichi told reporters, maintaining the island chain was "a unique territory of [Japan] historically and under international law".

The countries have been locked in a dispute over the Kurils for decades, and it is the main reason Moscow and Tokyo did not sign a peace treaty after World War Two.

The Kuril islands sit between Hokkaido in northern Japan and Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula. Four of the southernmost islands are claimed by Japan, which calls them the Northern Territories.

They are administered by Russia. At the end of World War Two, the Soviet Union annexed the island chain and deported around 17,000 Japanese residents.

During his visit, Putin sampled fish roe and spoke to island locals, Russian state media reported.

Speaking from the prime minister's office on Thursday, Takaichi said his trip "wounds the feelings of the Japanese people" and is "incompatible with Japan's consistent position on the Northern Territories".

"I hope that the Russian side will take the gravity of this matter very seriously," she said.

Earlier that day, Japan's foreign minister Toshimitsu Motegi said the islands were "inherently Japanese territory both historically and under international law, and the Government of Japan strongly protests this visit".

Over the years, attempts to resolve the territorial dispute have made little progress. Bilateral ties have also remained frosty, with Japan imposing sanctions against Russia for its invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

Japan has protested against previous visits by Russian officials to the disputed islands, including Russian Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin and his predecessor Dmitry Medvedev.

The Kuril islands are a strategic area for Russia, which has beefed up its military presence on the islands over the past decade. The island of Iturup is used as its primary military air base in the region.

Last month, Chinese and Russian naval warships sailed through a strait in the Kuril islands during a joint patrol.

Russia also holds regular military drills near the islands, drawing condemnation from Japan.
body.zh: 日本表示“强烈抗议”俄罗斯总统普京访问有争议的岛链。 俄罗斯官方媒体周四报道称，普京访问了伊图鲁普岛——在日本被称为择捉岛——俄罗斯和日本均声称拥有主权的千岛链上的四个岛屿之一。 日本外务大臣茂木敏充表示，这些岛屿“无论在历史上还是在国际法上都是日本固有领土，日本政府强烈抗议这次访问”。 几十年来，两国围绕千岛群岛一直存在争议。 这一争端是莫斯科和东京在第二次世界大战后未能签署和平条约的主要原因。 千岛群岛位于日本北部的北海道和俄罗斯堪察加半岛之间。日本声称对最南端的四个岛屿拥有主权，称其为北方四岛。 它们由俄罗斯管理。第二次世界大战结束时，苏联吞并了该岛链并驱逐了约 17,000 名日本居民。 据俄罗斯官方媒体报道，普京在周四访问期间品尝了鱼子，并与岛上当地人进行了交谈。 这些岛屿是俄罗斯军事行动的战略要地，伊图鲁普被用作俄罗斯在该地区的主要军事空军基地。 上个月，中国和俄罗斯海军军舰在联合巡逻中穿过千岛群岛的一个海峡。 俄罗斯去年也在这些岛屿附近举行了军事演习，引起了日本的谴责。

title.en: Colombia earthquake: Rescue operation enters 'final phase'
title.zh: 哥伦比亚地震：救援行动进入“最后阶段”

summary.en: Rescuers are racing against a critical 72-hour window to find survivors after a magnitude 7.4 earthquake that has killed 265 people, left hundreds missing, and displaced tens of thousands across western Colombia.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.zh: 哥伦比亚西部发生7.4级地震，造成265人死亡、数百人失踪、数万人流离失所，救援人员正在紧锣密鼓的72小时内寻找幸存者。 自哥伦比亚遭受强烈地震以来，救援人员已连续第三个晚上开展工作，时间已接近 72 小时。援助机构认为，这段时期对于寻找幸存者来说最为关键，不过，如果被困人员能够获得食物和水，这一时期可能会延长。 卡利市市长亚历杭德罗·埃德尔表示：“我们正在进入最后阶段。”他补充说，事后仍有可能找到幸存者，但几率会越来越低。他说，工作人员仍在废墟下探测生命迹象，并敦促加快速度：“每一分钟都至关重要。” 总统阿韦拉多·德拉埃斯普里埃拉周三表示，地震造成的死亡人数已攀升至 265 人。 德拉埃斯普里埃拉表示，大约有 3,500 人受伤，近 500 人仍下落不明，不过家属使用的众包追踪网站显示的失踪人数要高得多，已超过 4,100 人。他说，总共有超过 25,800 个家庭受到影响。 周一早上，哥伦比亚西北部乔科地区的圣何塞德尔帕尔马附近发生了里氏 7.4 级地震，这是哥伦比亚数十年来的最强地震。飓风席卷了哥伦比亚西部的城市，其中卡利和佩雷拉以及马尼萨莱斯和基布多是受灾最严重的城市。 在卡利，志愿者救援人员约翰娜·桑切斯 (Johana Sanchez) 描述说，救援队每 30 分钟就会停下来倾听幸存者的声音。她告诉法新社：“到目前为止，三人已被救出，三人死亡。” 官员称，140 座建筑物完全倒塌，数千所房屋受损或被毁。 在帕尔米拉，圣地亚哥·略雷达 (Santiago Lloreda) 告诉路透社，地震夺走了他的母亲和他 13 个月大的女儿萨尔玛 (Salma) 的生命。萨尔玛还太小，无法记录指纹，需要通过 DNA 测试来确认身份。他将母亲描述为家庭的看护人，称她“放弃了一切来照顾孩子”。 一位只向新闻机构透露了名字的男子里卡多从迈阿密赶来寻找妹妹的尸体，并表示他的侄女正在等待颅骨骨折、下巴和腿部骨折以及肺部塌陷的手术：“她还活着。我们知道她会好起来的。” 数千人无家可归，许多人睡在户外的公园里，或者在学校和运动场设立的紧急避难所，要么是因为他们的房屋被毁，要么是因为担心余震。 自周一地震以来，哥伦比亚地质部门已记录了 130 次余震。 在地震震中乔科，应对工作尤其困难，这是一个偏远贫困的地区，几十年来已经陷入紧张状态……

reflection.en: This story draws attention to compassion for vulnerable people. Galatians 6:2 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with practical compassion and welcome, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.

title.en: US: Karoline Leavitt to step down as Trump's spokesperson
title.zh: 美国：卡罗琳·莱维特将辞去特朗普发言人一职

summary.en: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt is to leave her job at the end of the month, President Donald Trump says. Leavitt, 28, is the youngest-ever person to have held the position.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt is to leave her job at the end of the month, President Donald Trump says. Leavitt, 28, is the youngest-ever person to have held the position.

Karoline Leavitt , will leave her role as White House press secretary at the end of the month, US President Donald Trump  said Tuesday.

Leavitt is one of the best-known faces and most ardent defenders of the MAGA movement .

Trump said in a post on his Truth Social platform that Leavitt was stepping down to "spend more time with her beautiful young children and family," adding that it was "a decision I totally understand and respect!"

Leavitt, now 28, who took on the job in January 2025 aged 27 at the start of Trump's second term in office, has been the youngest-ever White House press secretary.

She recently returned from parental leave after giving birth to her second child, a daughter, in May. She also has a 2-year-old son.

After initially wanting to be a journalist, Leavitt soon entered politics. She joined the White House press office during Trump's first term, working under then-spokeswoman Kayleigh McEnany.

After Trump lost the 2020 presidential election to Joe Biden, Leavitt worked for the office of Congresswoman Elise Stefanik, a highly loyal Republican supporter of Trump.

Leavitt later unsuccessfully ran for a seat in the House of Representatives in 2022.

She also   worked as a spokesperson for MAGA Inc., a super PAC supporting Trump, before joining his successful 2024 campaign.

"Serving as the White House Press Secretary over the past year and a half has been the honor and adventure of a lifetime," Leavitt wrote. 

"I am incredibly grateful to President Trump for granting me so many extraordinary opportunities, such as working in the West Wing and spending countless hours in the Oval Office, flying around the world and meeting foreign leaders, and traveling across our beautiful country and meeting Americans from all walks of life."

She said her "bittersweet decision to depart the White House" was due to the difficulties of combining motherhood with the demands of the White House position.

Leavitt, who Trump says will remain "one of my top outside advisors, and an influential voice within the Republican Party," has been a key figure in promoting the president's ideology and views, sometimes stretching the truth to do so.

Her very first press conference, on January 28, 2025, was notable for her false claim that $50 million (€43.4 million) in US taxpayers' money had been earmarked to buy condoms in the Gaza Strip .

Since then, she has staunchly defended Trump's hard-line policies while deflecting questions such as those concerning the president's ties with the sex offender Jeffrey Epstein...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，白宫新闻秘书卡罗琳·莱维特将于本月底离职。 28 岁的莱维特是担任该职位的最年轻的人。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周二表示，卡罗琳·莱维特将于本月底辞去白宫新闻秘书一职。 莱维特是 MAGA 运动最著名的面孔和最热心的捍卫者之一。 特朗普在他的“真相社交”平台上发帖称，莱维特辞职是为了“花更多时间陪伴她美丽的孩子和家人”，并补充说这是“我完全理解和尊重的决定！” 现年 28 岁的莱维特于 2025 年 1 月在特朗普第二个任期开始时上任，当时年仅 27 岁，是有史以来最年轻的白宫新闻秘书。 她最近在五月生下第二个孩子（女儿）后刚刚休完育儿假。她还有一个2岁的儿子。 莱维特最初想成为一名记者，但很快就进入了政坛。她在特朗普的第一个任期内加入白宫新闻办公室，在时任发言人凯莉·麦肯尼 (Kayleigh McEnany) 的领导下工作。 特朗普在 2020 年总统选举中输给乔·拜登后，莱维特在国会女议员埃莉斯·斯特凡尼克 (Elise Stefanik) 的办公室工作，她是特朗普高度忠诚的共和党支持者。 莱维特后来竞选 2022 年众议院席位失败。 在加入特朗普成功的 2024 年竞选活动之前，她还曾担任支持特朗普的超级政治行动委员会 MAGA Inc. 的发言人。 “过去一年半担任白宫新闻秘书是我一生中的荣幸和冒险，”莱维特写道。 “我非常感谢特朗普总统给了我这么多非凡的机会，比如在西翼工作，在椭圆形办公室度过无数个小时，飞往世界各地并会见外国领导人，以及穿越我们美丽的国家并会见各行各业的美国人。” 她说，她“离开白宫的决定苦乐参半”是因为很难将母亲身份与白宫职位的要求结合起来。 特朗普称莱维特仍将是“我的高级外部顾问之一，也是共和党内有影响力的声音”，他一直是宣传总统意识形态和观点的关键人物，有时甚至会夸大事实。 她于 2025 年 1 月 28 日举行的第一次新闻发布会因虚假声称美国纳税人的资金已指定 5000 万美元（4340 万欧元）用于在加沙地带购买安全套而引人注目。 从那时起，她坚决捍卫特朗普的强硬政策，同时回避有关总统与性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的关系等问题……

title.en: How North Korea has profited from its support for Russia
title.zh: 朝鲜如何从对俄罗斯的支持中获利

summary.en: North Korea's autocratic leader is consolidating power through exceptionally high revenues, primarily from war aid to Russia. This economic boom benefits only a small number of people within the country.
summary.zh: 朝鲜的独裁领导人正通过向俄罗斯提供战争援助而获得异常高的收入，从而巩固其权力。该国的少数人正从这场经济繁荣中获益。

body.en:
Exceptionally high revenues, particularly from war aid for Russia, are consolidating the power of North Korea's autocratic leader. A small number of people in the country are benefiting from an economic boom.

For years, satellite images of North Korea at night showed only a few small patches of light. Electricity shortages meant that even cities remained dark. In the six years since April 2020, however, the illuminated area in the center of Pyongyang has tripled in size.

The information portal NK News sees the increased illumination of the urban area as evidence that the regime has prioritized the supply of electricity to new streets and houses in the center to showcase its achievements.

At the last party congress in 2021, Kim Jong Un , North Korea's leader, announced that he would build 50,000 new apartments in the capital. And he did embark on the plan: in the new neighborhood of Hwasong, for example, with the construction of two 40-story apartment blocks shaped like Hwasong intercontinental ballistic missiles.

The new high-rise districts are not the only sign of North Korea's improved prosperity. People who have been visiting Pyongyang for a long time report that the city now appears more modern.

There are many imported cars, including electric cars from China , smartphone apps with QR codes to make payments or to call taxis, and department stores that stock Western fashion brands and cosmetics.

The regime has completed construction in Pyongyang of the biggest hospital in the country and a hothouse the size of New York's Central Park. In June 2025, Kim officially opened the five-kilometer-long (3.3 miles) beach resort of Wonsan-Kalma on the east coast, with space for 20,000 guests.

In June, the Wall Street Journal described North Korea as the "world's most unlikely growth story."

The dictatorship is presumably able to finance this sudden upturn thanks to the substantial income from its involvement in Russia's war against Ukraine .

According to a report by the South Korean Institute for National Security Strategy (INSS) in March, North Korea earns between $7.7 billion and $14.4 billion (€6.7 billion and €12.5 billion) from the sale of munitions to Moscow and the deployment of troops. Bloomberg Economics recently estimated that between 2022 and 2025, North Korea earned more than $14 billion by providing military support for Russia.

Furthermore, it brought in another $8 billion through trade with China , the provision of North Korean workers to other countries, export business and online criminality. The hacking of the ByBit platform in February 2025 was one of the world's biggest cryptocurrency heists. title.en: Trump's fiercest defender? Five moments defining Karoline Leavitt's time as press secretary
title.zh: 特朗普最坚定的捍卫者？定义卡罗琳·莱维特新闻秘书生涯的五个时刻

summary.en: Karoline Leavitt has been a highly visible and loyal figure within the Trump administration, known for her role as a press secretary.
summary.zh: 卡罗琳·莱维特在特朗普政府中一直是一位备受瞩目且忠诚的人物，以其新闻秘书的角色而闻名。

body.en:
Karoline Leavitt is leaving her post as White House press secretary after 20 months marked by fierce loyalty to United States President Donald Trump and fiery clashes with the media.

As Trump's highest-ranking spokesperson, the 28-year-old became known for her unwavering defences of the president, her embrace of MAGA and "new media" voices including podcasters and influencers, and her amplification of false, misleading and highly contentious claims from the podium.

Trump announced she was leaving her role at the end of the month to spend more time with her family, and would continue to serve as one of his "top outside advisors, and an influential voice within the Republican Party". Leavitt has two young children, the first born during Trump's 2024 presidential campaign and the second in May this year.

She was the first White House press secretary history to give birth while serving in the role, and the youngest person ever to hold the position.

Leavitt has been press secretary since Trump returned to office in January last year, making her the president's second-longest-serving press secretary after Sarah Huckabee Sanders, who served from 2017 to 2019.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Trump's next press secretary will be his sixth across two terms. He is yet to indicate who may replace Leavitt.

Leavitt and White House communications director Steven Cheung revamped the Trump administration's already-confrontational posture toward the media.

The Trump administration began handpicking which journalists would receive access to the president, overhauling the long-running system established by the independent White House Correspondents Association.

The "press pool" was traditionally a rotation chosen by the industry group to ensure media outlets had uniform access to the president and could relay his activities to the public and to other journalists who could not attend smaller gatherings.

In one of Leavitt's first moves as press secretary last year, she introduced a "new media seat" in the White House briefing room. Continuing Trump's longstanding attacks on establishment journalists, she vowed to give new media voices a more prominent role in covering his presidency.

"We welcome independent journalists, podcasters, social media influencers and content creators to apply for credentials to cover this White House," she said in January 2025.

title.en: 'Automatically ineligible': New Eurovision rule changes who can host the contest
title.zh: “自动失去资格”：欧洲歌唱大赛新规则改变了谁可以主办比赛

summary.en: Organizers of the Eurovision contest have announced new rule changes, stating that these adjustments are intended to offer enhanced clarity and safeguard the integrity of the competition.
summary.zh: 欧洲歌唱大赛的组织者宣布了新的规则修改，称这些调整旨在提供更大的清晰度并保护比赛的完整性。

body.en:
Eurovision Song Contest organisers announced overnight they were excluding any country involved in an armed conflict from hosting the competition and increased the minimum age of competitors.

While they did not mention any country by name, Israel, which has been at war in Gaza since 2023 , came close to winning the competition in both 2025 and 2026, ultimately finishing second on each occasion.

Under the old rules, the winning country normally hosts the following year's competition.

Under the new rules, "the winning broadcaster will automatically be ineligible to host the contest if an armed conflict, a sensitive geopolitical situation, or any other situation materially affects the security, safety or stability of their state or immediate region", the organisers said in a statement.

In a first, five countries — Spain, Ireland, the Netherlands, Slovenia and Iceland — boycotted the 2026 competition in Vienna over Israel's participation.

They said they could not take part alongside Israel because of its war in Gaza .

A United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry (COI), which does not speak on behalf of the UN as a whole and has been criticised by Israel, concluded in September 2025 that Israel is committing genocide in Gaza.

Israel is separately defending a genocide case at the International Court of Justice (ICJ), which has ordered Israel to implement provisional measures to ensure genocidal actions are not committed in Gaza, but has yet to issue a final ruling.

Martin Green, director of the Eurovision Song Contest, said in a statement that the changes had been guided by feedback from member countries.

He added: "These changes are about giving everyone involved greater clarity, protecting artists and ensuring the contest continues to provide a safe and welcoming environment, while preserving the spirit and integrity that make the Eurovision Song Contest so special."

The organisers also announced that competitors must be at least 18, up from 16, on the day of their first rehearsal.

"This change continues the work already undertaken by the contest to strengthen safeguarding and protect younger artists from the pressures associated with competing at the Eurovision Song Contest," they added in the statement.

The youngest person to win the contest was 13-year-old Sandra Kim from Belgium in 1986, according to Eurovision records.

Eurovision is a co-production of public broadcasters belonging to the European Broadcasting Union. Since the EBU includes members from outside Europe, the contest is not limited to European countries.

title.en: Israeli settlers keep up siege of Palestinian homes in West Bank after clashes with troops
title.zh: 以色列定居者在与部队冲突后继续围困约旦河西岸的巴勒斯坦人住宅

summary.en: Israeli settlers maintained a siege on Palestinian homes in the West Bank, leaving residents without essential supplies like food and medicine. The military publicly condemned the settlers' actions.
summary.zh: 以色列定居者在约旦河西岸持续围困巴勒斯坦人的家园，导致居民缺乏食物和药品。军方谴责了定居者的行为。

body.en:
The Israeli military said overnight it would deploy additional troops to restore order after failing to end a blockade by Israeli settlers of Palestinian homes in the occupied West Bank.

The siege began on Sunday, when settlers erected a makeshift tent near homes in the Palestinian village of Qusra, south of Nablus, preventing essential food and medical supplies from reaching residents.

Israeli troops clashed with the settlers while trying to disperse them from the outpost they set up directly in front of Palestinian homes, according to witnesses.

The incident marked a rare confrontation between settlers and the military and comes amid a sharp increase in settler land seizures and attacks on Palestinians.

All Israeli settlements and outposts in the occupied West Bank are illegal under international law.

"We have received no food and no medicine," Qusai Abu Rida, a Palestinian trapped inside one of the houses, told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency by telephone, adding that he had only managed to secure electricity thanks to solar panels.

The Israeli military condemned the settlers' actions and declared the area a "closed military zone", removing their tent on Wednesday morning (local time).

By mid-afternoon, an AFP photographer at the scene said the military had left and the tent had been removed, but the settlers were still there.

"The army has withdrawn, and so far we are still besieged, with the settlers at our doorstep," he said.

Later on Wednesday, the military announced it would send an additional infantry battalion and that more soldiers would be on standby.

The chief of the general staff "directed that efforts to strengthen order and operational control in the area continue, as well as efforts to prevent further serious incidents", a military statement said.

A day earlier, the Israeli military said it had received reports of settlers entering and taking control of Palestinian homes and land in the area.

"This is illegal, reprehensible and unacceptable activity that harms the residents of the areas and disrupts their daily lives," it said.

It also said that disciplinary action would be taken against security personnel who had been filmed at the site days earlier.

Violence by Israeli settlers towards Palestinians in the West Bank has persisted for years , often with little or no legal consequence, but recent months have seen a surge in attacks .

Last Sunday, Israel's military closed the West Bank village of Taybeh to non-residents to prevent growing attacks on Palestinians by Israeli settlers. Taybeh is one of the only Christian villages remaining in the West Bank.

title.en: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt to leave job this month, Donald Trump says
title.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普表示，白宫新闻秘书卡罗琳·利维特将于本月离职

summary.en: Karoline Leavitt, White House press secretary, is reportedly leaving her position this month. The 28-year-old recently returned to her role after taking leave for the birth of her second child in May.
summary.zh: 白宫新闻秘书卡罗琳·利维特（Karoline Leavitt）据报道将于本月离职。这位28岁的官员在五月生下第二个孩子后，最近才从产假中返回白宫。

body.en:
White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt, who earned a reputation for acid putdowns of journalists, is to step down, United States President Donald Trump announced on Thursday AEST, adding she would remain a senior adviser.

Leavitt, 28, the youngest-ever US presidential spokesperson, has been a fiercely loyal Trump defender, delivering fluent and aggressive performances at often combative press briefings.

"Our wonderful White House Press Secretary, and one of my most trusted aides , Karoline Leavitt, will be departing her role at the end of the month so she can spend more time with her beautiful young children and family," Trump said on social media.

"Karoline will now be one of my top outside advisors, and an influential voice within the Republican Party."

In May, Leavitt announced the birth of her second child — a girl named Viviana — just days after delaying her maternity leave following an alleged assassination attempt on Trump when a gunman tried to storm the White House Correspondents' Dinner .

Her departure comes as Trump faces steadily sinking poll numbers and the Republican Party risks defeat in the November midterm congressional elections.

"I am thankful to the President for entrusting me with the distinct privilege of speaking on his behalf at the White House podium," Leavitt said on social media as her departure was announced.

"I have relished holding the liberal media accountable and ensuring the American people hear the truth about President Trump’s successes."

Leavitt wrote that, after returning to the White House following the birth of her daughter, "I have felt in my heart that I cannot be the best mom my two young children deserve" while devoting the attention needed as press secretary.

Leavitt is a Trump veteran who served in his press office during his first term that ended in 2021 and then as his spokesperson during his 2024 election campaign.

Leavitt's tenure as press secretary saw a revival of regular briefings that had petered out during the first term, but she presided over a sea change in White House interactions with journalists.

In February 2025, she stunned the press corps when she announced that the White House itself — and not an independent association of correspondents — would choose which reporters got to cover Trump up close in the Oval Office and on Air Force One.

She also facilitated press credentials from right-wing, pro-Trump media outlets, diluting the presence of traditional news media that tend to ask more challenging questions in the briefing room.

title.en: Taiwan says it was hit by ‘abnormal’ AI-assisted cyber-attack
title.zh: 台湾称遭受“异常”人工智能辅助网络攻击

summary.en: Taiwan reported detecting "abnormal" AI-assisted cyber-attacks on government agencies last month, originating from overseas. These attacks represent a new kind of threat, with suspected links to China-based hackers.
summary.zh: 台湾报告称，上个月侦测到来自海外、由人工智能辅助的“异常”网络攻击，目标是政府机构。这些攻击代表了一种新型威胁，据称与中国相关黑客有关。

body.en: Taiwan’s statement comes a day after reports that suspected China-linked hackers had carried out a first-of-a-kind breach Taiwan says it detected AI-assisted cyber-attacks on government agencies that came from overseas last month, a new kind of threat that has been reported as “first-of-a-kind breach”. The Ministry of Digital Affairs (MDA) said its cybersecurity monitoring units ‌detected the “abnormal attack” targeting government agencies, which began on 20 July. The National Institute of Cyber Security issued a series of warning alerts while it investigated. Continue reading...
body.zh: 台湾发表声明的前一天，有报道称疑似与中国有关的黑客实施了史无前例的违规行为。台湾表示，上个月检测到来自海外的针对政府机构的人工智能辅助网络攻击，这是一种新的威胁，被报道为“史无前例的违规行为”。数字事务部 (MDA) 表示，其网络安全监控单位检测到 7 月 20 日开始的针对政府机构的“异常攻击”。美国国家网络安全研究所在调查过程中发布了一系列警告。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The emergence of AI-assisted cyber-attacks highlights the constant need for vigilance in a rapidly changing world. Proverbs 27:12 reminds us that wisdom lies in foreseeing danger and taking appropriate refuge. As technology evolves, so must our discernment and protective measures, trusting Yahweh for guidance.
reflection.zh: 人工智能辅助的网络攻击的出现，凸显了在快速变化的世界中保持警惕的持续必要性。箴言27:12提醒我们，智慧在于预见危险并采取适当的避难措施。随着科技发展，我们的洞察力和保护措施也必须随之进步，信靠雅伟的指引。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: With Hollywood struggling in China, can the Odyssey draw a crowd?
title.zh: 好莱坞在中国市场举步维艰，《奥德赛》能否吸引观众？

summary.en: Christopher Nolan's summer blockbuster, "The Odyssey" (likely Oppenheimer), is set for release across China's Imax screens. This comes at a time when Western films generally face difficulties in the Chinese market, and the film itself has reportedly overcome significant opposition.
summary.zh: 克里斯托弗·诺兰的夏季大片《奥德赛》（很可能是《奥本海默》）将在中国各地的IMAX影院上映。目前西方电影在中国市场普遍举步维艰，而这部影片据报道也克服了来自世界首富的猛烈攻击。

body.en: Christopher Nolan’s epic will be released on Friday across most of the country’s 800 Imax screens, at a time when western films have been struggling The Odyssey, Christopher Nolan’s summer blockbuster juggernaut, has overcome an onslaught of attacks from the world’s richest man and stared down criticism from a classicist who translated the poem , to become one of the year’s most celebrated and highest-grossing films. But this week, the film faces one of its biggest challenges yet. Continue reading...
body.zh: 克里斯托弗·诺兰的这部史诗巨制将于周五在全国 800 块 Imax 银幕上上映，当时西方电影一直在苦苦挣扎，克里斯托弗·诺兰的夏季大片《奥德赛》克服了来自世界首富的猛烈攻击，也顶住了翻译这首诗的古典学家的批评，成为今年最著名和票房最高的电影之一。但本周，这部电影面临着迄今为止最大的挑战之一。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Launching any major endeavor, like a film in a challenging market, requires immense effort and hope for success. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our work to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans. Even when facing significant headwinds, we can find peace in knowing that our diligent efforts are seen and can be blessed.
reflection.zh: 在充满挑战的市场中推出一部电影这样的大型项目，需要付出巨大的努力并寄予成功的希望。箴言16:3提醒我们，要将我们的工作交托给雅伟，相信他会成就我们的计划。即使面对重重阻力，我们也能在知道自己的辛勤努力被看见并蒙福时找到平安。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Zhu Rongji obituary
title.zh: 朱镕基讣告

summary.en: Zhu Rongji, the fifth premier of the People’s Republic of China, has passed away at 97. He was widely recognized as an economic reformer who famously declared China 'the factory of the world' and was regarded as one of the country's most effective administrators.
summary.zh: 中华人民共和国第五任总理朱镕基逝世，享年97岁。他被广泛认为是经济改革家，曾宣布中国成为‘世界工厂’，并被视为该国最有效的管理者之一。

body.en: Premier of the People’s Republic of China regarded as an economic reformer who declared that the country had become ‘the factory of the world’ Zhu Rongji, who has died aged 97, was the fifth premier of the People’s Republic of China and one of its most effective administrators and economic reformers following its foundation in 1949. In 1991, Zhu was summoned to Beijing, in the footsteps of the then president and party secretary Jiang Zemin , and in the aftermath of the 1989 uprisings in Beijing and the collapse of the Soviet Union. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中华人民共和国总理被誉为经济改革家，宣称中国已成为“世界工厂”。 朱镕基去世，享年 97 岁。朱镕基是中华人民共和国第五任总理，也是自 1949 年建国以来最有效的管理者和经济改革家之一。1991 年，朱镕基追随时任国家主席兼党委书记江泽民的脚步，在改革开放之后被召唤到北京。 1989年北京起义和苏联解体。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The passing of a leader like Zhu Rongji marks the end of a significant chapter, reflecting a life dedicated to public service and economic reform. His legacy reminds us that every life is a race run, with efforts and impacts that shape the world around us. Yahweh invites us to consider how we too might finish our own race with integrity and purpose.
reflection.zh: 朱镕基这样一位领导人的逝世，标志着一个重要篇章的结束，反映了他一生致力于公共服务和经济改革。他的遗产提醒我们，每个人的一生都是一场赛跑，其努力和影响塑造着我们周围的世界。雅伟邀请我们思考，我们又将如何以正直和目标跑完自己的赛程。

verse.textEn: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
verse.textZh: 那美好的仗我已经打过了，当跑的路我已经跑尽了，所信的道我已经守住了。

title.en: Zhu Rongji, who helped turn China into a trading giant, dies at 97
title.zh: 朱镕基逝世，享年97岁，他曾助中国成为贸易巨头

summary.en: Former Chinese Premier Zhu Rongji, credited with helping transform China into a major trading power through reforms and its entry into the WTO, has died at the age of 97.
summary.zh: 中国前总理朱镕基去世，享年97岁。他因推动改革和中国加入世界贸易组织，帮助中国成为贸易巨头而受到赞誉。

body.en:
Former Chinese Premier Zhu Rongji, who spearheaded China's entry into global trade and laid the foundation for its explosive growth, has died at the age of 97.

He served in the country's second-highest office from 1998-2003 and played a leading role in securing its entry into the World Trade Organization, opening Chinese factories to the international market and drawing foreign investment.

He was one of the most important economic reformers who moved local tax powers to the central government, closed or privatised failing state firms and promoted home ownership.

Many in China remember him as a tough and pragmatic leader who delivered double-digit growth and was rarely afraid to speak his mind.

In 1998, he said China was facing "many potential crises that could erupt at any time...

"Ordinary people are discontent about us in many ways. Especially, there is corruption among officials, the gulf between rich and poor and the way some local officials act like tyrants."

He labelled rogue bankers as "half-wits" and said the dams and flood dykes lining the Yangtze River were as "flimsy and porous as tofu dregs".

Under his leadership, which helped stabilise the economy and tackle corruption, China began transforming into a manufacturing powerhouse, leaving behind its status as a Communist outsider.

Though he faced criticism because those reforms also led to 30 million lay-offs over five years, and with huge growth came more inequality.

Chinese state media describe Zhu Rongji's life as one of "revolution, struggle and brilliance".

He was born in the central province of Hunan in 1928 and earned a degree in electrical engineering before joining the civil service.

He joined the Communist Party in 1949, but was purged twice - first after criticising Mao Zedong's economic policies as "irrational" and being labelled a "rightist", and again during the Cultural Revolution.

Zhu was brought back into the fold after Mao's death, and by 1991 had risen to the role of vice-premier in charge of China's economy.

Zhu led China through difficult negotiations to enter the World Trade Organization in 2002.

In state media his obituary described him as an "outstanding member of the Communist Party of China and loyal Commnist fighter... an outstanding leader of the Party and state".
body.zh: 中国前总理朱镕基去世，享年97岁。朱镕基是中国进入全球贸易的带头人，为中国的爆炸性增长奠定了基础。 1998年至2003年，他在中国第二高职位任职，在确保中国加入世界贸易组织、中国工厂向国际市场开放和吸引外国投资方面发挥了主导作用。 他是最重要的经济改革家之一，他将地方税收权力移交给中央政府，关闭或私有化破产的国有企业，并促进住房所有权。 许多中国人都记得他是一位强硬而务实的领导人，实现了两位数的增长，而且从不害怕说出自己的想法。 1998年，他表示中国面临“许多随时可能爆发的潜在危机…… “普通人在很多方面对我们不满。特别是官员腐败、贫富差距和一些地方官员的暴君行为。” 他将流氓银行家称为“笨蛋”，并称长江沿岸的水坝和防洪堤“像豆腐渣一样脆弱、多孔”。 在他的领导下，中国稳定了经济并解决了腐败问题，开始转变为制造业强国，摆脱了共产主义局外人的地位。 但他也面临批评，因为这些改革也导致五年内 3000 万人失业，而且巨大的增长带来了更多的不平等。 中国官方媒体将朱镕基的一生描述为“革命、奋斗、辉煌”的一生。 他 1928 年出生于中部湖南省，在加入公务员队伍之前获得了电气工程学位。 他于1949年加入共产党，但两次遭到清洗——第一次是在批评毛泽东的经济政策“非理性”并被贴上“右派”标签之后，第二次是在文化大革命期间。 毛泽东去世后，朱重回国门，并于 1991 年升任副总理，主管中国经济。 2002年，朱镕基带领中国通过艰难的谈判加入世界贸易组织。 官方媒体的讣告将他描述为“优秀的中国共产党党员、忠诚的共产主义战士……党和国家的杰出领导人”。

reflection.en: Zhu Rongji's legacy highlights how a leader's clear vision and commitment to reform can profoundly shape a nation's trajectory. His efforts to integrate China into the global economy provided a guiding direction that fostered significant growth and transformation. This reminds us of the importance of wise leadership that offers a clear path forward for...
reflection.zh: 朱镕基的遗产彰显了一位领导者清晰的远见和改革承诺如何深刻地塑造一个国家的轨迹。他将中国融入全球经济的努力提供了一个指导方向，促进了显著的增长和转型。这提醒我们，提供明确前进道路的智慧领导对社会至关重要。

verse.textEn: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom's instruction.
verse.textZh: 没有异象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。

title.en: Mass evacuations in Beijing as Typhoon Dolphin brings more torrential rain to China
title.zh: 台风海豚带来更多暴雨，北京大规模疏散

summary.en: Forecasters warned the Chinese capital could receive more than one-third of its average annual rainfall over 24 hours Thousands of people have been evacuated from areas at risk of flooding and landslides in Beijing, as the remnants of Typhoon Dolphin continue to bring torrential...
summary.zh: 预报员警告称，中国首都北京在24小时内可能迎来超过年平均降雨量三分之一的降水。随着台风“海豚”的残余继续带来暴雨，北京数千人已从有洪水和山体滑坡风险的地区撤离。

body.en: Forecasters warned the Chinese capital could receive more than one-third of its average annual rainfall over 24 hours Thousands of people have been evacuated from areas at risk of flooding and landslides in Beijing, as the remnants of Typhoon Dolphin continue to bring torrential rain to northern and central China. Forecasters warned on Tuesday that the Chinese capital could receive more than 150mm of rain over the following 24 hours, with some districts forecast to exceed 200mm – more than one-third of Beijing’s average annual rainfall of 528mm. Continue reading...

reflection.en: As Beijing faces torrential rains and evacuations, the immediate need for safety and shelter is paramount. In times of natural disaster, we are reminded that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Even amidst the chaos, we can find solace and resilience in His unwavering presence.
reflection.zh: 当北京面临暴雨和疏散时，对安全和庇护的即时需求至关重要。在自然灾害面前，我们被提醒雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。即使在混乱之中，我们也能在祂坚定不移的同在中找到慰藉和韧性。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Floods, storms and landslides: Typhoon Dolphin ravages China – in pictures
title.zh: 洪水、风暴和山体滑坡：“海豚”台风肆虐中国——图集

summary.en: Typhoon Dolphin, the most powerful tropical cyclone to hit China this year, has caused widespread damage along the country's east coast. It brought strong winds, torrential rain, and severe flooding, with Beijing bracing for a significant portion of its annual rainfall in a single day.
summary.zh: 今年袭击中国的最强热带气旋“海豚”台风给中国东海岸带来了大风、暴雨和洪水，造成了广泛破坏。北京正准备迎接其年降雨量三分之一的雨水在24小时内降临。

reflection.en: The immense power of Typhoon Dolphin reminds us of creation's vulnerability and the deep impact natural forces can have on human lives and infrastructure. In moments when the earth itself seems to groan under the weight of storms, we are called to acknowledge the broader suffering of creation.
reflection.zh: “海豚”台风的巨大威力提醒我们，受造界是脆弱的，自然力量能对人类生活和基础设施造成深远影响。当地球本身似乎在风暴的重压下呻吟时，我们被呼召去认识到受造界更广泛的苦难。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: The China factor in the United States' $500 million move in a tiny Australian town
title.zh: 美国在澳大利亚小镇投资5亿美元的“中国因素”

summary.en: The Pentagon is investing $500 million in a small Australian town in New South Wales, a move attributed to strategic considerations related to China. The reason for this sudden interest in a town of only 130 people is its role in broader international geopolitical dynamics.
summary.zh: 五角大楼正在澳大利亚新南威尔士州的一个小镇投资5亿美元，此举被认为是与中国相关的战略考量。这个只有130人的小镇突然受到关注，是因为它在全球地缘政治动态中的作用。

body.en:
The town of Fifield near Parkes is about a six-hour drive west of Sydney, and at the last Census was home to about 130 people. Now, the town has found itself at the centre of a major strategic play by the United States government.

The US Department of War has committed to make a conditional loan of US$400 million (about $566 million) to Sunrise Energy Metals, an Australian mining company hoping to deliver the world’s first supply of a key critical mineral outside of China.

Scandium is listed as a critical mineral in both Australia and the US, signalling its strategic importance in aerospace and defence.

This loan is another chapter in the US government’s search for secure critical mineral supply chains to reduce its dependency on Chinese supply. But success will require sustained investment and government support.

Scandium is a highly strategic metal used to produce ultra-high-strength alloys needed for the most advanced fighter jets. It is also used in solid oxide fuel cells, crucial for providing reliable power to artificial intelligence (AI) data centres.

First, demand for scandium is being driven by massive increases in defence spending across North America, Europe and Asia and an investment boom in power-hungry AI data centres.

Second, China’s sweeping export controls on rare earth elements, including scandium, have contributed to a persistent shortage of supply on the global market, pushing up prices.

These export controls are designed to maintain China’s dominance of supply chains for key critical minerals and slow down the US defence and industrial base.

Still, the market for scandium is tiny. According to statistics from the US Geological Survey, the entire world only consumed 60 tonnes of the metal in 2025.

Scandium is usually found in very small quantities. For that reason, until now, it has been exclusively produced as a byproduct of nickel and titanium processing.

This is what sets the Sunrise Energy Metals project apart — the proposed mine has scandium deposits in a high enough concentration to be the first primary source of scandium in the world.

If production goes ahead, and lives up to its promise of producing 60 tonnes of high-purity scandium each year by 2028, this would be enough to completely satisfy the current level of global demand.

According to the company, there is also potential to expand the project in the future and add another 120 tonnes of production.

The deal gives the US government first rights to purchase scandium from Sunrise Energy Metals, with production expected to start in late 2028.

title.en: Worldview 'gulf' behind strained Australia-China ties, former Australian ambassador says
title.zh: 前澳大利亚大使称，世界观“鸿沟”是澳中关系紧张的幕后原因

summary.en: Australia's former ambassador to China identified "diverging worldviews" as a key obstacle to fostering a robust relationship between the two nations.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚前驻华大使指出，“世界观差异”是澳中两国建立健康关系的主要障碍之一。

body.en:
Australia is unlikely ever to have a true partnership with China due to a mismatch of worldviews, rendering it pointless to pursue that goal, the nation's former top diplomat to China says.

But in an analysis piece for the Lowy Institute, Australia's former ambassador to China Graham Fletcher noted several wildcards, such as Chinese military action in Taiwan , could still disrupt the "modest new normal" of the relationship.

The change in government at the 2022 federal election acted as a circuit-breaker in increasingly fraught dealings between the nations, although they had still been marred by intimidatory military encounters involving Chinese forces, he said.

China sparked widespread international condemnation over its launch of a ballistic missile into the South Pacific in July following the signing of a landmark mutual defence alliance between Australia and Fiji.

The Albanese government sought to stabilise relations with China after diplomatic tensions peaked during the COVID-19 pandemic under then-prime minister Scott Morrison's leadership.

China slapped $20 billion in trade sanctions on Australian exports, measures that have slowly been wound back.

China is Australia's largest trading partner and is the destination for about a third of the nation's exports.

Fletcher said China had not given up hope of drawing Australia closer into its orbit, while Australia was more focused on consolidating its current relationship.

"But this relationship is unlikely ever to become genuinely close — like the relaxed, intimate fellowship Australia enjoys with like-minded partners elsewhere in its region and beyond," he said.

"The gulf in terms of diverging world views and national security agendas is simply too wide.

"It would be pointless for Canberra to pursue such a goal; it recognises this and is realistic."

The "mismatch" of world views made the relationship vulnerable to disruption, with key risks including another round of serious disagreements or the cataclysm of a conflict, including the use of force against Taiwan.

"An upheaval or conflict is always a possibility, though not in my opinion a strong one at present," the former diplomat said.

Australia would be on firmer ground when facing China if policies had cross-party support and politicians did not "seek to exploit difficulties for domestic advantage", Fletcher said.

"Bipartisanship produces policy consistency and limits China's ability to play games within the Australian system," he said.

body.zh: 澳大利亚前驻华最高外交官表示，由于世界观不匹配，澳大利亚不太可能与中国建立真正的伙伴关系，因此追求这一目标毫无意义。 但澳大利亚前驻华大使格雷厄姆·弗莱彻在洛伊研究所的一篇分析文章中指出，一些不确定因素，例如中国在台湾的军事行动，仍然可能破坏两国关系的“适度新常态”。 他说，2022 年联邦选举中的政府更迭为两国之间日益令人担忧的交易起到了断路器的作用，尽管它们仍然受到涉及中国军队的恐吓性军事冲突的损害。 在澳大利亚和斐济签署具有里程碑意义的共同防御联盟后，中国于 7 月向南太平洋发射弹道导弹，引发了国际社会的广泛谴责。 在时任总理斯科特·莫里森 (Scott Morrison) 的领导下，新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 疫情期间外交紧张局势达到顶峰后，阿尔巴尼亚政府寻求稳定与中国的关系。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 中国对澳大利亚出口产品实施了价值 200 亿美元的贸易制裁，但这些措施已慢慢取消。 中国是澳大利亚最大的贸易伙伴，也是该国约三分之一出口的目的地。 弗莱彻表示，中国并未放弃将澳大利亚拉近其轨道的希望，而澳大利亚则更专注于巩固当前的关系。 “但这种关系不太可能变得真正亲密——就像澳大利亚与其地区及其他地方志同道合的伙伴所享有的轻松、亲密的友谊一样，”他说。 “世界观和国家安全议程的分歧实在太大了。 “堪培拉追求这样的目标是毫无意义的；它认识到这一点并且是现实的。” 世界观的“不匹配”使得两国关系容易受到破坏，其主要风险包括新一轮严重分歧或爆发冲突，包括对台湾使用武力。 这位前外交官表示：“动乱或冲突总是有可能发生，尽管我认为目前可能性不大。” 弗莱彻表示，如果政策得到跨党派支持，并且政客们不“寻求利用困难谋取国内利益”，那么澳大利亚在面对中国时将会更加坚定。 “两党合作带来了政策的一致性，并限制了中国在澳大利亚体系内玩弄游戏的能力，”他说。 弗莱彻于 2019 年至 2023 年担任澳大利亚驻中国大使，并于 2014 年领导谈判团队，帮助两国签署了自由贸易协定……

title.en: More than one million evacuated, flights cancelled, as Typhoon Dolphin hits China

summary.en: Typhoon Dolphin has led to the evacuation of over one million people and the cancellation of flights in China. The cyclone previously swept across Japan, causing injuries to six people and cutting power to more than 50,000 buildings.
summary.zh: 台风“海豚”袭击中国，导致逾百万人撤离，航班取消。此前，该气旋已横扫日本，造成六人受伤，并导致超过五万栋建筑断电。

body.en:
Typhoon Dolphin brought heavy rain to eastern China on Monday, causing hundreds of flight cancellations even as the storm weakened and some cities resumed public transport.

The typhoon had already swept across Japan’s southern Okinawa prefecture, injuring six people and cutting power to more than 50,000 buildings.

It then made landfall near Yuhuan in eastern Zhejiang province on Sunday evening, China's meteorological authorities said.

The storm packed maximum sustained winds of 151km/h near its centre at landfall, equivalent to a Category 1 hurricane on the Saffir-Simpson scale.

Authorities had moved offshore workers to safety, ordered vessels back to port and increased checks at reservoirs, mountain streams, landslide-prone areas, construction sites and tourist locations.

The weather system lost power after making landfall, with China's National Meteorological Centre (NMC) issuing its least severe typhoon alert on Monday morning.

However, the NMC warned that parts of east and central China would continue to receive heavy rain for the next day.

The typhoon had triggered a top-level alert over the weekend, prompting over 1,000 flight cancellations and tens of thousands of evacuations.

Transport was widely disrupted across the east of the country, and more than one million people were evacuated from their homes.

Nine hundred and forty-three flights from Shanghai's two main passenger airports were cancelled, the airport authority said in an online post.

A 42-year-old tourist from Guangdong said he was stranded in Shanghai after his family's flight, scheduled to depart on Sunday, was cancelled due to Typhoon Dolphin.

He said the family had been rebooked on a flight at 10pm on Monday, although they were unsure whether it would be able to take off.

"To us Guangdong people, this typhoon is as ordinary as having a meal and feeling the wind. It's just part of everyday life," he said, adding that the storm did not appear particularly strong by the standards of China's southern coast.

In neighbouring Zhejiang province, the city of Wenzhou relocated more than 900,000 residents and opened more than 1,000 emergency shelters.

In Fujian province, authorities evacuated 98,900 people from high-risk areas after raising the typhoon emergency response to Level 3, according to Xinhua. Zhejiang, Shanghai and Jiangsu have also activated Level 3 emergency responses.

Fujian maritime authorities said 55 coastal passenger ferry routes had been suspended, all 115 offshore construction projects had been halted, and 290 construction vessels had been moved to sheltered waters.

body.en:
A former high-ranking Catholic known for hosting alcohol-fuelled parties has been convicted of sexually abusing two young Aboriginal men.

Former Bishop of Broome Christopher Alan Saunders, 76, was found guilty of 13 sex offences on Thursday   following a jury trial in the West Australian District Court.

The offending between 2008 and 2019 included one count of sexual penetration without consent and a dozen unlawful and indecent assault charges.

He was acquitted of six other charges, including two counts of indecently dealing with a child over 16 under his authority and four counts of unlawful and indecent assault.

Saunders was ordained as the second Broome bishop in 1996 and presided over 13 schools and nine parishes, before stepping aside in 2020 when the sex abuse claims became public.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Unless acquitted on appeal, Saunders would be the highest-ranking Catholic in Australia convicted of sexual abuse while a member of the clergy.

The late Cardinal George Pell was found guilty in 2018 but later acquitted by the High Court of raping one choirboy and molesting another in 1996.

Prosecutors said Saunders, known as Brother B by his victims, put on alcohol-fuelled parties at Catholic Church-owned properties to get access to Aboriginal boys and men so he could sexually assault them.

"The accused had a sexual interest in young Aboriginal men and a tendency to act on that interest when the opportunity presented itself," prosecutor Adam Ebell said.

Saunders, who studied law before becoming the first diocesan priest ordained in WA's Kimberley region in 1976, exploited the power imbalance between himself and the younger men, he said.

The main complainant, who cannot be named for legal reasons, said he was aged 16 when the then-bishop started grooming him at a Broome home in regular visits during which he was given alcohol.

The interactions over the decade that followed involved kissing, naked wrestling, touching of private areas and penetrative sex, he said.

His lawyer Tony Hager attacked the three complainants, saying they were convicted criminals with long records who had abused alcohol and drugs during their lives, which impacted their memories.

Saunders was initially on trial for 30 sexual assault charges, but four charges related to a child under the age of 13 were removed from the prosecution on the first day of proceedings.

He was acquitted of a further seven charges mid-trial due to insufficient evidence being presented to the jury.

title.en: 130,000 people: One Nation clarifies plan for major migration cut
title.zh: 13万人：一国党澄清大规模移民削减计划

summary.en: A key detail behind One Nation's headline migration pledge has now come into focus.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
One Nation has confirmed its plan to significantly limit migration to Australia to 130,000 people a year will be based on the net overseas migration forecast.

Australia's migration level has become one of the most combustible debates in federal politics, as the nation faces a housing shortage and pressure on services, particularly in suburban areas.

Migration experts have warned of the dangers of political parties attempting to blame migrants for a lack of homes , arguing that migrant workforces will be essential to building the required housing stock .

The net overseas migration measure is forecast by projecting how many people will enter and depart the country; it includes returning Australians.

This measure includes visitor and tourist options, family and partner visas, working holidaymakers, skilled migration, plus refugee and humanitarian programs.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Under Labor, net overseas migration reached a record high of 556,000 in 2023, following the COVID-19 pandemic.

But Labor has moved to tighten restrictions, projecting net overseas migration to fall to 225,000 people by the 2027-2028 financial year.

The government is preparing to unveil a plan to wind back migration settings to ensure the net overseas migration forecast is met.

Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke was set to unveil that plan at the National Press Club last week — but it was put on hold after cabinet jitters about the political implications of cuts to certain programs.

According to its website, One Nation's policy is "capping visas at 130,000 per year to ease pressure on housing, wages, and infrastructure".

A One Nation spokesperson has confirmed to SBS World News that the cap of 130,000 will be on net overseas migration.

That is a dramatic reduction from the current numbers, which the government maintains would affect a range of visa categories and impede productivity nationwide.

But One Nation leader Pauline Hanson maintains the government has been too reliant on migration to keep the economy going.

Meanwhile, Nationals and senior Liberals have distanced themselves from a figure the Opposition's housing minister suggested cutting immigration to.

Andrew Bragg used a National Press Club speech on Wednesday to argue for a Coalition policy of capping net overseas migration at 180,000.

But Nationals leader Matt Canavan has already cautioned against any moves that would reduce the workforce in regional areas.

On Thursday, Opposition leader Angus Taylor said Bragg was expressing personal views and didn't run the speech by him before he delivered it.

title.en: Australia's next total solar eclipse is coming. Here's when and where to see it
title.zh: 澳大利亚的下一次日全食即将到来。以下是观看时间和地点

summary.en: Australia's next total solar eclipse will deliver a rare spectacle across parts of the country.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
As millions turned out to see the total solar eclipse over Europe, some Australians may be wondering when it will be our turn to enjoy such a spectacle.

If you're among them, there's some good news: Australia's next total solar eclipse is on the horizon, and it will bring a rare celestial spectacle to parts of the country.

A total solar eclipse is when the moon's orbit passes between the Earth and the sun. For a few moments, the three planetary bodies align. The moon almost perfectly blocks the sun from view, plunging the planet below into a brief darkness.

That's quite different to the partial solar eclipse. In a partial solar eclipse, the orbits of the Earth, moon, and sun align, but the moon only obscures part of the sun.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

It's rare for total solar eclipses to happen anywhere. It's rarer still for them to happen in Australia. There have been just five total solar eclipses visible from Australia in the last 50 years — two close together in 1974 and 1976, then long gaps between eclipses in 2002, 2013 and 2023.

Even then, the word "visible" has done some heavy lifting. Most total eclipses only graze the Australian continent, passing over a northern or southern tip. The 2023 total eclipse, for instance, passed just off the North West Cape region of Western Australia and then transited northeast over Indonesia and Papua New Guinea.

The 2028 total solar eclipse, also referred to as the Great Australasian Eclipse in some quarters, will start on Saturday 22 July 2028. As the name suggests, the moon will completely obscure the sun for those on the ground.

It will pass south-west across the Australian continent from the Kimberley in northern Western Australia. The eclipse path will then move across the Northern Territory, south-western Queensland and rural NSW, and finally arrive directly over Sydney.

For those in the Kimberley, the total eclipse will begin at around 11am AWST. In Sydney, the total eclipse will start at 2pm AEST. It will last for around four minutes as the moon passes in front of the sun.

To put the rarity of an eclipse path of this kind into context, 2028 will be the first time Sydney has experienced a total solar eclipse since 1857. According to NASA, it won't happen again for another 800 years — 3 June 2858.

When the 2028 eclipse passes over Dunedin in New Zealand later that afternoon, it will be the first to do so since 1163.

But what about Australian cities other than Sydney? Will you be able to see the eclipse?

title.en: Low-income Australians should accept substandard homes, Liberal frontbencher says
title.zh: 自由党前座议员表示，低收入澳大利亚人应该接受不合格的住房

summary.en: Another Liberal frontbencher said some Australians could put "a jumper on in winter" instead of stricter housing standards.
